title.narrative: Integrated Tourism and Urban Development Program for the Colonial City of Santo Domingo

description.narrative: The main objective of the project is to revitalize the urban, economic, and cultural tourism aspects of the Colonial City of Santo Domingo (CCSD) by: (i) restoring public spaces, museums, and heritage monuments; improving urban mobility; and improving solid waste management and collection; (ii) improving habitability conditions for low-income residents; and (iii) developing local economies.
